_comment: Per-asset Info.plist facts read straight out of the downloaded release IPA (Payload/*/Info.plist, binary plist parsed the same way build-system/lib/bplist.pm reads them). Keyed by the asset's SHA-256 so a release can never be matched to the wrong extraction. schema holds the SideStore/AltStore-app-level metadata that is not inside Info.plist. Every new release's workflow entry is appended by .github/workflows/appsource-update.yml after the IPA is downloaded and its hash is recomputed.
